blurb: Capt. Jim Bennett offers inshore and nearshore fishing charters targeting species such as Tarpon, Snook, Redfish, Cobia, and more. The charters take place in Clearwater, Palm Harbor, Dunedin, Tarpon Springs, and Tampa Bay, featuring diverse fishing environments like beaches, mangroves, creeks, rivers, and grass flats. The service caters to both advanced anglers and families, providing customized fishing experiences year-round.
